input_encoding: JSON null for NULL; signed canonical decimal strings for INT32; JSON strings for STRING; nested JSON arrays for rows/ARRAY; result BOOLEAN is true/false string
scope: Three parent #902 investigations: actual repeated eager expression, explicit subquery alias lineage, and a user logical sort below outer SLICE. No expected winner, forced CSE, sort retention, opaque UDF parity, or new compatibility category is encoded. This does not expand or block bounded #914.
input_order_contract: The original four slice_priority rows and required schema are unchanged. A single-partition RDD preserves manifest row order; provider and raw k IN (0,1) selection are roundtripped before the query catch. Those checks establish source order, not the order after the logical sort. Output key k is column 3; actual rows and all raw plans are preserved even if optimization removes the user sort.

provenance.reuse: Self-contained derivative of the frozen 902 capture/verifier: typed decode, canonical encode, structured Java/Python causes, single-partition input roundtrips, all schema stages, exclusive raw capture, and mutation checks. No DAR outcome is an oracle.
